_note: v2.4 plan 03 live gate 1 (+ gate 6, Try again half). Real model, real extraction at cadence 1, so-scenario --sandbox --group 1759606632088, lanes only. The extraction profile (a Connection Manager profile separate from the main one) is repointed IN MEMORY to a dead port right after boundary A's cadence read has left, so the main model keeps answering and only the memory model dies; the original url is kept in localStorage so a crashed run is healed by the next run's first step, and a page reload restores it anyway (the change is never saved). Boundaries in the dead period are /sendas replies (a 'command' reply commits a boundary without a main-model call). Asserts: extraction.enabled stays true throughout (sampled every 200 ms, live and stored); the pipeline reads stalled-rechecking with Try again; no audit is written while dead; Try again sends a probe (which fails, so the breaker stays open); a boundary while open adds at most one held job; after the url is restored the backoff probe closes the breaker within one backoff step with no click, and the held read runs (an audit covering boundary B). assert-player-clean runs in player mode while Try again is visible. Every model request is recorded in-page (kind, timing, llama timings) and reported at the end.

requires.why: the breaker is opened by repointing the memory model's Text Completion api-url at a dead port; a Chat Completion source such as deepseek ignores api-url, so the breaker never opened on the T7 lanes and the run left the url behind (SUITE.md live-2/live-3 residue)
